verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents several ways to run Isaac Sim on your own infrastructure: Docker containers, pip/conda Python packages, standalone scripts, and building your own wheels from the public GitHub repo. Isaac Lab is open source and runs standalone and headless from a workstation up to a data center or cluster, and Isaac ROS deploys on workstations and Jetson. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that a self-hosted install of the core simulator works, and clear licensing terms for Isaac Sim itself (the open-licence evidence covers only GR00T).
